methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Athanor operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector populated by one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The target's stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, limiting precision in peer selection.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The Robotics & Manufacturing sector contains ten same-sector comparables, but filtering for stage alignment, adjacent-stage proximity, or valuation-tier similarity yielded fewer than three datapoints in each narrow category—the minimum threshold required for reliable median estimation. Broader sector-wide median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of robotics sub-segments and company maturity levels.

Without sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peer clustering, traditional triangulation cannot be reliably executed. A credible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. To advance valuation work, disclosure of Athanor's stage, capital raised to date, and operational metrics (revenue, deployment scale, or customer concentration) would enable meaningful comparison against the private peer set or construction of alternative methods (e.g., revenue multiple analysis, DCF sensitivity). At present, analyst commentary on valuation range would exceed what the data justifies.
